business_problem: IBM needed to overcome fragmented financial and workforce planning data spread across hundreds of applications so analysts and executives could forecast, plan, and make decisions without relying on siloed tools and spreadsheet-heavy handoffs.
solution_summary: IBM built its Enterprise Performance Management platform as a unified data and planning environment powered by IBM Cognos Analytics, IBM Planning Analytics, and IBM watsonx.ai. Cognos gives users a single experience for exploring performance insights, while Planning Analytics adds forecasting and became the core driver of forecast accuracy after being infused into production with AI capabilities in 2019. The platform links historically siloed sources through an integrated data model and supports a "touchless" forecasting process that predicts roughly 140,000 data points each month. Self-service dashboards and standardized workflows replaced more than 500 finance tools with fewer than 20, and the same Planning Analytics foundation later powered SCORE for workforce planning across IBM Consulting. The result is an enterprise planning stack where finance and workforce decisions draw from common historical data and AI-enhanced scenario planning instead of disconnected applications.
